name: cascade
description: Cascade / tumble mechanic as a pure subgraph (invariant 2/4: no C# class, no Board type). Implements the remove-and-refill-in-place tumble: winning cells (positions in state['winningPositions'], produced by the host's win evaluator such as cluster/scatter) are replaced in the board (state['board']) by fresh symbols drawn into state['refill'] (a same-size board the host draws each cascade). Non-winning cells are kept. The host wires this inside a capped Loop that re-evaluates after each tumble and stops when there are no wins. Column-gravity tumble (vs. positional refill) requires a future bounded reshape primitive. Uses index-aware map + contains + index over state arrays. Input/output port: 'state'.

nodes.label: Remove Winners and Refill In Place
